Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Radhika Mishra. I am a 49-year-old orthopaedic surgeon living in Mangaluru. Swati Shinde has filed a police complaint against me over 55.7 lakh rupees, and the complaint turns a business disagreement into a criminal case. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 06650615460 or email radhika.mishra48@example.in.
